purpose: Evaluate a supplementary replay of the moving front liquid contact at both printed-volume sightlines from preview pixels. The earlier upper-strip timing assay remains fixed.
fitting_evidence: First twenty fresh programs, indices zero through nineteen, only. No fill, repeat or later fresh image outcomes were used to choose this reader.
exposure: The full native photograph before the pour supplies one starting row at each site. The final photograph is consulted only to score the independently reconstructed displacement. The release calculations use the actual submitted last zero and closure receipt. This is retrospective image reconstruction, with no use of head direction during tracking.
test: For fresh indices at least twenty, for all fill and for all repeat runs, at least ninety percent of the planned pours in each cohort on each sightline must reconstruct signed net motion to within one six-pixel preview pitch of the two full-resolution endpoint photographs. Count missing results as misses. Report errors, fractions, and release-to-closure movement by head; a successful reconstruction assesses a retrospective optical readout, not serving-dose accuracy.
